name: 300-W: 300 Faces in-the-Wild Challenge Dataset
description: A premier benchmark created by the Intelligent Behaviour Understanding Group (iBUG) at Imperial College London for 2D facial landmark localization across challenging unconstrained real-world imagery. Standardized a consistent 68-point markup scheme across existing databases (LFPW, Helen, AFW, XM2VTS) and added an entirely new 600-image test set divided into challenging indoor and outdoor scenes with severe facial expressions, lighting variations, and head poses.
